claim_boundary: V1-V6 spans establish hash integrity and V9 owner-family lineage only. They are not claimed as line-by-line V10 semantic equivalents.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Single discoverable controller with layered runtime ownership
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: The single controller remains discoverable while runtime ownership is split into typed atom owners.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Progressive disclosure across controller, routes, detailed procedures, acceptance crosschecks and evidence
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: Progressive disclosure is represented by a thin controller, route contract, and domain atom bundles.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Atomic migration ledger and capability-test binding
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: The old span ledger is lineage-only; reviewed V9 capabilities now bind directly and bidirectionally to tested V10 atoms.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Responsibility overlap analysis and canonical ownership decisions
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: Canonical ownership and conflict analysis are separate observable obligations.
R0, R1, and R2 remain distinct recovery dispositions.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Distinct start and end receipt semantics
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: Start and end receipt authenticity remain separately checked.
The machine-readable registry remains, with routing obligations split into four executable atoms.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Scaffold artifact contract and bootstrap validation
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: Scaffold control is preserved as inspection, lazy structure, consumer admission, and minimal creation.
Component typing, evidence, transition gating, and route recording are independently enforced.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: S6 requires both solution verification and model examination
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: The dual-axis S6 requirement has one direct V10 owner.
Implementation and numerical verification are decomposed into E1 and E2 atoms.

v7_v8_dispositions.source_capability: Assumption, structure, parameter and reality examination axis
v7_v8_dispositions.rationale: Structural and reality examination are decomposed into E3 and E4 atoms.
Dual-axis evidence is now bound at both route selection and typed state-transition gates.
The former dedicated regression guard is retained as two V10 behavior cases bound to the S6 atom.
